title: Meta Engineer Laid Off After 13 Years Describes a Company Transformed by AI

title: Greg Abel says energy supply is a key opportunity for Berkshire in the AI buildout
description: Berkshire Hathaway sees supplying energy to AI data centers as a significant opportunity while building a nearly $36 billion stake in Alphabet. CEO Greg Abel bought $10 billion of Alphabet stock directly from the company at a 6.5% discount this spring.

title: Remote Work, AI and the Future of Seattle's Commute
description: Seattle's average one‐way commute shortened by 2.5 minutes between 2019 and 2024 as remote work persists and AI tools increase, affecting downtown businesses and traffic patterns, signalling a lasting shift in how people commute, work and the city evolves
